discrepancies.issue: page-02.png panel 26 header reads '0:25 - 0:22' (end time 0:22); storyboard.json has 25–26s. Confirmed on the downloaded image.
discrepancies.resolution: Use storyboard.json timing 0:25–0:26 (start 25s, end 26s). Image text left as-is; corrected image still requested from ChatGPT.

discrepancies.issue: Image: bare fingers lower a flour-coated piece into the oil. prompts.json: 'battered chicken being carefully lowered into hot oil with tongs'. Utensil (and batter look) differ.
discrepancies.resolution: Use long cooking chopsticks or tongs; hands kept away from hot oil (safety); close composition kept.

discrepancies.issue: Image: bare fingers add pieces to the hot oil. prompts.json: 'Close hands adding the next chicken pieces with tongs'. Utensil differs (also a hand-safety concern).
discrepancies.resolution: Use long cooking chopsticks or tongs; hands kept away from hot oil (safety); close composition kept.

discrepancies.issue: Image: chopsticks lift a piece above the frying pan, no rack in frame. prompts.json: 'Tongs lifting fully cooked golden chicken onto wire rack'. Utensil and destination differ.
discrepancies.resolution: Follow storyboard: long cooking chopsticks lifting from pan toward rack; 'tongs' replaced in the derived generation prompt.

discrepancies.issue: Image and prompt both show tomatoes, but no tomato appears in the plating sequence s48–s54 or in s67. Continuity question for the creative lead.
discrepancies.resolution: No tomatoes; finished dish consistent with s49-s54 (chicken, cabbage, egg tartar, parsley); s70 reference crop excludes the tomatoes.
